20077159.reason: Chooses the input coordinate nearest the arithmetic mean; minimizing sum of absolute distances instead requires the left median. Test 0003 selects 10 instead of 22.

20077452.reason: Discards the result of sorted(a) and uses a[0] and a[n-1] as ternary-search bounds. In test 0004 these are 457 and 424, so the search never executes and prints its sentinel -1 instead of 64.

20080460.reason: Uses sorted a[n//2], choosing the right median for even n. For coordinates 1,2,3,4 the required leftmost optimum is 2, not 3.

20082668.reason: For odd n uses sorted x[n//2+1], one position to the right of the median. Test 0002 returns 6 rather than 2. Its even-n midpoint rule also violates the leftmost-optimum requirement.

20082729.reason: For even n prints the floored arithmetic mean of all coordinates rather than the left median. Test 0003 returns 12 instead of 22.
